Chandra.name: Chandra Deva
Chandra.note: Chandra Deva (also Soma), the radiant deva of the moon and of the soma nectar; progenitor and eponym of the Chandravamsha, the lunar dynasty from which both the Kurus and the Yadavas descend.

Budha.name: Budha Deva
Budha.note: Budha Deva, the deva of the planet Mercury and son of Chandra; husband of Ila.

people.Pururavas: Son of Budha and Ila; first emperor of the lunar line, famed for his love of the apsara Urvashi.
people.Nahusha: Son of Ayus; so mighty he briefly took Indra's throne, then fell for his pride and became a serpent.
people.Yayati: Son of Nahusha; a great emperor cursed with old age, which his youngest son Puru bore for him. His five sons founded five peoples.
people.Yadu: Eldest son of Yayati and Devayani; progenitor of the Yadavas (the Yadu line), into which Krishna is born.
people.Turvasu: Son of Yayati and Devayani; ancestor of the Yavana peoples.
people.Druhyu: Son of Yayati and Sharmishtha; ancestor of the Bhoja peoples.
people.Anu: Son of Yayati and Sharmishtha; ancestor of the Mleccha peoples.
people.Puru: Youngest son of Yayati and Sharmishtha; he gave his own youth to his aged father and so inherited the throne, founding the Paurava (Kuru) line.
people.Dushyanta: A Paurava emperor descended from Puru through several generations; husband of Shakuntala and father of Bharata.
people.Bharata: The great emperor son of Dushyanta and Shakuntala, after whom the land Bharatavarsha and the Bharata clan are named.
people.Hastin: A Bharata king, some generations after Bharata; founder of Hastinapura, the Kuru capital.
people.Kuru: King some generations after Hastin; eponymous ancestor of the Kurus and of the field of Kurukshetra.
people.Kroshtu: Son of Yadu; the Yadava kings descend from him.
people.Vrijinivat: A Yadava king, son of Kroshtu.
people.Swahi: A Yadava king of the early Yadu line.
people.Rushadru: A Yadava king of the early Yadu line.
people.Madhu: A Yadava king; progenitor of the Madhava branch, whence Krishna's epithet Madhava. Several generations separate him from Vrishni.
people.Vrishni: A Yadava king; eponym of the Vrishni clan of Krishna and Vasudeva.
